purpose.en: Gently relax and move your hips through rotation.

text.zh: 双膝一起慢慢倒向一侧，脚踩稳
text.en: Let both knees tip slowly to one side with your feet planted

text.zh: 仰卧屈膝，双脚比髋略宽，手臂放两侧
text.en: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet a bit wider than hips, arms by your sides.

text.zh: 停一下，经过中间再倒向另一侧
text.en: Pause, then pass through the middle to the other side.

commonErrors.en: Letting the shoulders lift off the floor.

cautions.zh: 腰或髋疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your lower back or hips hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
